truth_description: Marcus signs the draft of his revised will at Whittle & Cross, removing Isabella and the clinic and naming his nephew Thomas. Whittle notes Marcus's handwritten addendum: 'if R. contests, she may have legal standing.' Whittle asks; Marcus says Ruth Calder — the postwoman. He says no more.
player_description: The solicitor's office shows a recent appointment for Marcus Bell.

truth_description: Ruth arrives at Marcus's house with an envelope — the original copy of her birth certificate, which she has been holding for thirty years. She confronts him: he has always known and never acknowledged her. He tells her the will revision is not about her — the money goes to Thomas. She can contest if she likes, but she will lose.

Ruth returns home and goes to her garden. She cuts the foxglove stems she has been preparing for three days and extracts the glycoside into a small vial on her kitchen range. She has read about cardiac glycosides in an old pharmacy text — she knows the right amount.
Isabella learns of the revised will from a second draft copy left on Marcus's study desk. There is a fierce argument. Isabella leaves at 20:00, furious.
player_description: A heated conversation behind closed shutters at Marcus's house in the early evening.

truth_description: Priya passes the square at 20:00 and sees Isabella exit Marcus's house looking white with anger. Priya notes the time — she has a 07:00 appointment with Marcus tomorrow.
player_description: Priya passes the square and notices Isabella leaving Marcus's house.

truth_description: Ruth lets herself in with her spare key. She goes to the kitchen and adds the digitalis extract to Marcus's evening cocoa — already prepared on the sideboard, as always, ready to be heated. She places the birth certificate copy from the study into the fireplace and burns it.
Marcus heats his cocoa and carries it to the fireside armchair. He takes up his book.
Marcus dies in his chair of cardiac arrest induced by digitalis glycoside poisoning. He does not cry out. His book slides to the floor.
Ruth places the digitalis vial in her fireplace. She sits and reads until midnight.
Priya arrives for the 07:00 appointment and, getting no answer, finds the spare key under the mat. She discovers Marcus dead in his armchair, book on the floor, mug on the table. She calls for help.
player_description: Priya Shah finds Marcus Bell dead in his fireside chair. His cocoa mug sits on the table beside him. He appears to have died peacefully.
